findings.summary: Adds a third-party vendor's promotional demo badge with tracking link to the README (and PyPI description); maintainers don't control the image and shouldn't endorse it. Close.
Badge line placed directly above the --- rule turns into a setext heading and swallows the horizontal rule; also inconsistent with the other badges.

why: The first finding objects to a vendor-run demo being advertised from the project README, with the point that maintainers wouldn't control it, which matches the maintainer's reason of not advertising demos the core team doesn't maintain.
